_doc: Layer inventory for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 stubs all planned layers as not-yet-implemented entries so the engine can boot and the [data-ga-layer] chips have a registry to look up. Each layer's `tier` / `source` / `path` is the COMMITTED contract per SCHEMA §28; the actual files don't exist yet — they ship from the cluster-side genome-annotation pipeline (phase B+). Layers carrying `_optional: true` are facultative: when absent, the consuming page hides the corresponding panel rather than erroring.

_tier_legend.hot: RAM-pinned at trigger event; pages read state directly; <1ms
_tier_legend.warm: IndexedDB-cached at trigger event; first read async ~50ms; subsequent ~10ms

_round1_status: Eight layers (post-2026-05-19 meiosis migration) are CONTRACT-ONLY (not-yet-loaded). page1's scaffold renders them as '⚪ not loaded' chips. Phase B turns on chromosome_map + gene_track + repeat_track. The page3 CO-density sub-track reads crossover_track cross-atlas from meiosis-atlas (where it now lives). Layers carrying `_optional: true` are facultative — the consuming page hides the corresponding panel rather than erroring.

assembly_stats._feeds: page1 chromosome overview · QC banner (phase B)

gene_track._feeds: gene cargo per inversion · functional context (phase B/C)

repeat_track._feeds: TE landscape · breakpoint repeat enrichment (phase B)

te_hierarchy._feeds: page6 View 4 — TE-hierarchy alluvial (per parental haplotype, N-level)
te_hierarchy._source_pipeline: RepeatMasker / EDTA post-processing — aggregate bp per (haplotype, repeat, te_category, class, order, family) tree per Wicker et al. 2007
te_hierarchy._schema: { haplotypes: [ { id, name, label, column_headers?, nodes: [<node>] } ] }; <node> = { id, name, pct, palette?, children?: [<node>] }. pct = % of total genome; children sum ≤ parent.pct. Legacy { total_bp, classes:[...] } shape is auto-adapted by the renderer.

synteny_blocks._feeds: collinearity vs related Siluriformes · ancestral karyotype (phase D)

macrosynteny_orthologs._feeds: page9 View 3 — MacrosyntR-style Oxford macro-synteny grid (and linear macro-synteny in later rounds)
macrosynteny_orthologs._source_pipeline: OrthoFinder + BUSCO single-copy orthologs (or wfmash 1-to-1 alignments distilled to gene-anchor positions) — one JSON per species pair
macrosynteny_orthologs._schema: { pairs: [{ id, name, x: { id, name, chroms: [{ id, name, length_bp }] }, y: {…}, orthologs: [{ xc, xp, yc, yp }] }] }; positions in bp

centromere_telomere._feeds: centromere bands · T2T completeness chip (phase B)

layers._migration_note_2026_05_19: crossover_track, prdm9_motif, and nco_gc_track moved to meiosis-atlas on 2026-05-19. They describe meiosis events keyed by inversion candidate, not assembly/annotation features. The Genome Atlas page3 (chromosome overview) still consumes crossover_track for its CO-density sub-track, but reads it cross-atlas from meiosis-atlas's layers registry rather than declaring it here.
